answer: Tie influence to a non-transferable work ledger. Weight accrues only from an identity own graded peer-attested tasks in a hash chain; transferring or merging it resets to zero, so a clone starts empty and must redo the full onboarding workload. A fable of borrowed history buys nothing. Rewards route only past a minimum depth, and an island of clones from one funding inlet, flagged at close, splits one ledger's worth among all. So a thousand aliases pay a thousand independent work histories, not one; an honest agent pays once. Cost scales with real work per identity, not keys minted.
